main_issue: Who gets to use the shared living-room window corner (D's physio exercise mat vs A's desk, B's weekend guests, C's laundry rack) and how to schedule it

A-B.evidence: A prioritises medical need over guests (T20) and seeks workarounds for D; B keeps insisting the corner is needed on weekends (T21, T27).

A-C.evidence: A first needs the corner for the desk and C for laundry; A then proposes wheeled rack and plastic sheet (T24, T26) while C objects that it still drips (T25), so no real agreement.

A-D.evidence: A asks what time D needs (T3) and accepts mornings and evenings; D accepts before 9 and after 6 (T7-8); A backs D's medical need (T20).

B-C.evidence: B and C each defend their own use of the corner and never address each other; both resist D's request.

B-D.evidence: D asks to work around friends (T13, T16); B refuses that a slot is possible (T15, T17, T21, T27); D says the corner is off-limits on weekends (T23).

C-D.evidence: D asks C to move the rack for 30 minutes (T13); C says she can't move it twice a day (T18) and that it drips (T25), and stays firm.
